answers.core: OBJ files in 3D projects in widespread in the the Godot community makes this enhancement beneficial, warranting its inclusion in the core rather than as an add-on.
answers.workaround: The general utility of improved OBJ import across various types of projects justifies its implementation at the core level. A script workaround might not capture the depth of integration and performance optimization needed.
